mentions.name: Blackjack Wonk
mentions.description: A blackjack simulator and research tool focused on producing reproducible, trustworthy simulation results. Built with deterministic runs, validation, and configuration tooling so blackjack questions can be tested rigorously instead of relying on rules of thumb, anecdotes, or forum arguments. Started as a hobby project and mixes math, software, and curiosity.
mentions.problem: Blackjack questions are usually answered with rules of thumb, anecdotes, or forum arguments rather than reproducible, trustworthy simulations.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building a blackjack simulator/research tool called Blackjack Wonk.
